user_story: As a user on https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1, I want the page to reveal hidden content after an asynchronous wait so that I see the loaded result. Acceptance criteria: the '#finish' element is hidden initially; clicking the Start button ('#start button') shows a loading indicator '#loading'; after the loading indicator disappears, the '#finish' element becomes visible with the text 'Hello World!' (allow up to 10 seconds for the load to complete).
